### How You Can Search for Truth the Wise Way - Powerpoint - December 30
Author: Jack Graham (PowerPoint Ministries)
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/powerpoint-december-24-2013.html
Passage: Numbers 24:17
Points:
- Scripture reveals little about the wise men except that they were learned scholars from the east who studied ancient texts.
- They were likely familiar with the ancient prophecy of the star and scepter rising out of Israel.
- Seeing this celestial sign compelled them to leave everything behind and seek the newborn King.
- Genuine wisdom consists not merely in seeking information, but in recognizing and clinging to divine truth when encountered.
- Pursuing ultimate truth always leads the seeker to bow and worship at the feet of Jesus.
